commit: origin/main 34a27777 (#359 merged: a call line commits as c? and its speaker is a later seg revision)
clips: scripts/gates/g6-clips.sh (macOS say, voice Samantha), the same 24 sentences and 56 s stereo timeline as the 2026-10-07 run
command: AKOU_HOME=<scratch> AKOU_HEADLESS=1 AKOU_CAPTURE_FILE_ONLY=1 bun scripts/gates/g6-live-latency.ts --cli src/main/cli/cli.ts --clips <48k> --wav <timeline.wav> --words <the 12 words> --out <file>

config.capture.helper: a wrapper that runs akou-capture with --from-wav <timeline> --realtime

reading: latencyMs is the committed line (seg revision 1) minus the wall time the utterance's speech ended; speakerMs is when the line first carried a speaker other than c? (the same as latencyMs where revision 1 carries it). byChannel holds the median (p50) and the worst (max) per channel. The final pass fails in file mode (the wrapper adds --from-wav to the decode command); it is not part of G6.
machine: a Windows x64 box (the machine of the 2026-10-07 x64 run, Windows 11 Pro), pinned to four performance cores with one thread each: processor affinity 0x55, set with cmd start /affinity 55 and inherited by bun, akou-capture and akou-diarize (read back as 0x55 during every run)
helpers: akou-capture and akou-diarize built on the machine at 36a2237d on 2026-10-07 (since then only their version numbers changed)
conditions: runs one at a time, alternating diarizers, each started only with no GitHub Actions job running (no Runner.Worker process); CPU load 0 to 4 % after each run

rows.text: The ACA recorder keeps the microphone on the left channel.
Parakeet transcribes both sides of the call.
We moved the dashboards from Datadog to Grafana last week.
Silero decides where each segment starts and ends.
The Terraform Plan touched three Kubernetes clusters.
Please open a Zendesk ticket for the billing question.
TitaNet gives every speaker a voice print.
The final pass runs pianoed over the whole call.
ElectroBun hosts the window and the tray item.
Opus files stay playable while they are being written.
Can you share the Grafana link with the team?
Yes, the Kubernetes upgrade is scheduled for Friday.
I think Datadog was cheaper for us in the end.
Let us check what Akau heard in the last five minutes.
The Parakeet model runs on the CPU with two threads.
Zendesk and Terraform both need a new owner.
We should keep ElectroBun pinned until the next release.
Silero and TitaNet both run in the same worker.
Send me the Opus file after the call ends.
Who owns the Pianode configuration now?
The demo went well and the customer asked for pricing.
Thanks everyone. See you all next Tuesday.
Could you repeat the last number, please?
Okay, I will write the action items down.
